title: Zephyr: short address to IID
notes: Implemented Zephyr/C short-address IID module and production CMake integration. Mapping is byte-exact RFC 6282 0000:00ff:fe00:XXXX with big-endian XXXX, reverse canonical-prefix validation, explicit 0x0000/0xfffe/0xffff reserved classification, and fail-before-mutation errors. Dedicated shared vector table mirrors test/vectors/ipv6-addresses.json and adds 0x0000/0xfffd/0xfffe boundaries. Gates: standalone strict C + UBSan 1/1 passed; Clang static analyzer clean; local Zephyr qemu_cortex_m3 build/run 4/4 passed (FLASH 21879 B, RAM 5480 B); Python ipv6 parity 34/34; Rust lichen-core ipv6/short-address vector parity 9/9 using isolated target dir; diff check clean. native_sim configure was attempted but Zephyr POSIX architecture rejects macOS as Linux-only; qemu_cortex_m3 provided the local Zephyr execution path. clang-tidy/clang-format are not installed; strict compiler, analyzer, and Zephyr build were used.
